title: Notification
description: User notification with title, message, type, priority, read status, action URL, and timestamps. Used for notification systems, alert management, and user engagement platforms.

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who receives this notification

type.description: Notification type (e.g., like, comment, follow, mention, system)

priority.description: Notification priority level (e.g., low, normal, high, urgent)

read.description: Whether the notification has been read by the user

action_url.description: URL to navigate to when the notification is clicked

created_at.description: Timestamp when the notification was created

read_at.description: Timestamp when the notification was read, null if unread
